regions.region: page 1 full accepted-manuscript cover and citation panel
regions.finding: Accepted-manuscript publisher cover/citation page only. The inset is an unrelated Chemical Science issue cover; no current-paper reaction arrow, table, procedure, reagent quantity, or yield appears.

unresolved: No chemistry is present on this cover page; the actual article title begins on PDF page 2.

regions.region: page 2 title, abstract, authors, affiliations, and ESI placeholder
regions.finding: The actual article title was read from the page heading. The printed accepted-manuscript ESI sentence is a placeholder and does not establish a workspace SI association.

Five separate prior-work reaction classes were classified as literature examples: organometallic acylation, Rh/styrene hydroacylation, CuH/styrene hydroacylation, Pd/allene hydroacylation, and Cu boroacylation. They are not current-paper experiments.

regions.region: page 2 Scheme 1B current-work arrow and dashed regioisomer box
regions.finding: The generic allene/anhydride L*Cu reaction was classified as a general scheme; the α,β-unsaturated regioisomer is explicitly not observed. Aggregate example counts/maxima were not assigned as individual yields.

regions.region: page 2 beginning of Results and discussion
regions.finding: The initial optimization narrative continues into Table 1 on page 3 and does not define an additional prose-only experiment.

unresolved: Scheme 1 contains generic R groups and incomplete conditions; candidate structures remain label-only.

regions.region: page 3 left Table 1 header, entries 1–12, ligand drawings, and footnotes
regions.finding: Twelve independent racemic optimization runs were retained with ligand identity/loading, solvent, scale overrides, silane/Cu loadings, room temperature/6 h, NMR yields, and starting-allene recoveries. Entry 6 PCy3 is 5 mol%; entries 11/12 preserve scale/concentration ambiguities.

regions.region: page 3 upper-right Table 2 header, eight product drawings, and footnotes
regions.finding: Eight independent racemic scope experiments were retained with shared Cu(OAc)2/DPPE/silane/THF conditions, row-specific 9 h or 1.5-equiv allene overrides, and reported yields.

regions.region: page 3 lower-right Table 3 ligand screen and footnote
regions.finding: Nine independent chiral-ligand screens were retained. Signed ee strings are preserved exactly, (R)-SDP's 84% is recovery of allene rather than product yield, and all numerical yields remain NMR yields with CH2Br2 basis.

unresolved: Table 1 does not report its NMR internal standard.
Table 2 does not state yield basis.
ee analytical methods are not stated; all structures remain unverified.

regions.region: page 4 upper-left continuation of Table 3 discussion
regions.finding: Narrative comparison of the nine page-3 ligand-screen outcomes; it was linked to those existing rows rather than duplicated.

regions.region: page 4 left Table 4 entries 1–6 and footnotes
regions.finding: Six independent optimization rows were retained with silane equivalents, time, NMR yield, ee, and recovery/source markers. Entry 6 uses 2.5 mol% Cu/BPE on 1.0 mmol scale and is merged with the identical-condition Table 5 (R)-3aa row while retaining 86% NMR and 87% Table-5 yields separately.

regions.region: page 4 right Table 5 allene and anhydride substrate panels, product drawings, CCDC label, and footnotes
regions.finding: Twenty-three scope products were reconciled into twenty-three condition-specific experiments (one shared with Table 4 entry 6). All b/c/d footnote amount/loading overrides, R/S ligand choice, yields, ee values, and >99% bounds were retained. CCDC 1939837 is characterization of (R)-3ea, not another preparation or SI file.

regions.region: page 4 lower-right introduction to gram-scale/synthetic applications
regions.finding: The narrative introduces the distinct Scheme 2 experiments shown on page 5; no page-4-only duplicate was created.

unresolved: Table 5 does not state yield or ee measurement bases, workups, purifications, or product masses.

regions.finding: A distinct 10 mmol benzoic anhydride/15 mmol 1k run gives 2.4974 g (R)-3ka in 79% yield and 96% ee under 2.5 mol% Cu/(R,R)-Ph-BPE, 1.5 equiv silane, THF 0.1 M, room temperature/6 h.

regions.region: page 5 upper-left Scheme 2b arrows a–d and reaction-condition footnote
regions.finding: Four independent product transformations were retained: oxime formation (R,Z)-4, Suzuki product (R)-5, aldehyde-selective Wacker product (R)-6, and hydrogenated (R)-7. Every printed reagent/loading, solvent ratio, temperature/time, gas balloon, yield, and ee was structured.
The Cu-H/allylcopper/six-membered-transition-state/β-O-elimination cycle is a proposed mechanism, not a set of isolated preparations.

regions.region: page 5 upper-right Scheme 4 and lower-right Scheme 5
regions.finding: DFT hydrocupration transition structures and 1,3-Cu-shift isomerization network were classified as mechanism/computational records; printed energies are not experimental yields.

unresolved: Scheme 2b omits absolute scale, workups, purifications, product masses, yield bases, and ee analytical methods.
Schemes 3–5 depict proposed/computational intermediates rather than observed preparations.

regions.region: page 6 full Scheme 6a–c transition-state, quadrant, and geometry panels
regions.finding: The four computed TS3 pathways and ligand-quadrant steric model were classified as one DFT mechanism record. No new preparative reaction, reagent charge, or experimental yield occurs on this page.

regions.region: page 6 lower text and Conclusions beginning
regions.finding: Narrative interpretation of computed energy/geometry differences and the beginning of Conclusions add no new experiment. References to ESI detail were not used to infer an SI association.

unresolved: The page cites ESI for additional transition structures, but no SI file is explicitly associated in the workspace.
Computed structures/energies are mechanistic evidence, not independent experiments.
